responsibility: Implements analysis utilities over GCC’s loop structures for profitability, irreducibility, trip-count, and pressure reasoning. It marks irreducible loop regions and their edges, counts and averages loop-body insns, derives expected iteration counts and nesting levels, initializes target-specific loop cost constants, estimates register-pressure costs for loop transforms, marks loop-exit edges, selects likely exits, and extracts a loop’s hot path from edge probabilities. This file consumes loop, CFG, dominance, profile, and target-cost information to produce analysis facts used by loop optimizers.
